command: Final Vitest JSON report plus pnpm run config:schema:check

jsonSchemaRepresentable.summary: All represented objects reject unknown properties.
Manifest identity, release compatibility, database schema bounds, and PostgreSQL major are constrained.
Host values use the exact normalized lowercase FQDN grammar.
Exactly one ADMIN and one PORTAL surface entry is required.
DEVELOPMENT API listeners are explicit IPv4 loopback addresses in 127.0.0.0/8.
Configured API ports are integers from 1024 through 65535.
Shutdown timing and request body limits are bounded integers.
Agency bootstrap references and slugs use bounded DEVELOPMENT-safe identifiers.
Database name and exactly three opaque credential-reference identifiers are constrained.
The Stage 2 foundation health endpoint feature is required and enabled.

runtimeOnly.summary: Admin and Portal API listeners must not use the same host and port pair.
runtimeOnly.reason: Draft 2020-12 cannot compare two sibling property values for equality.

runtimeOnly.summary: Admin and Portal canonical hosts must differ.
runtimeOnly.reason: Draft 2020-12 cannot compare two sibling property values for equality.

runtimeOnly.summary: Each allowlist host must equal the canonical host declared for its surface.
